tickets.title: Analyze mortgage liquidity source options
tickets.text: Analyze mortgage liquidity source options for Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk, comparing bank cash, short‑term bond holdings, taxable brokerage sales, and vested employer shares while preserving at least $80,000 emergency reserves.
tickets.evidence: Julian asked for a mortgage liquidity source analysis comparing bank cash, short-term bond holdings, taxable brokerage sales, and vested employer shares to fund the remaining down payment while preserving the stated reserve target; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-10-08.

tickets.title: Upload required underwriting asset documents
tickets.text: Upload the latest Teacup Comet Bank statement and Velvet Acorn Custody brokerage statement and provide documentation linking the $25,000 earnest money withdrawal to its source account for the mortgage underwriter.
tickets.evidence: the underwriter is asking for documentation tying the earnest money withdrawal to the source account; this remains needed by 2025-10-06.

tickets.title: Review cash‑flow impact of rate‑lock choices
tickets.text: Review the cash‑flow effect of the mortgage rate‑lock alternatives provided by the lender for Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk before they respond to the loan terms.
tickets.evidence: Julian wants the cash-flow effect of the lock alternatives reviewed before he responds; the agreed review is due 2025-10-10.

tickets.title: Resolve student loan payment discrepancy
tickets.text: Resolve the discrepancy between the $640 monthly student loan payment listed in the mortgage application and the $410 income‑driven payment shown on Iris Nettlewhisk’s servicer statement for underwriting DTI calculations.
tickets.evidence: For the student loan payment discrepancy in the mortgage file, the mortgage application lists Iris’s student loan payment as $640 per month, while the current servicer statement provided by Iris shows a $410 income-driven payment, creating a different debt-to-income calculation for underwriting;

tickets.title: Update liquidity worksheet with current balances
tickets.text: Update the liquidity worksheet to reflect the current cash and short‑term bond positions in the joint Velvet Acorn Custody brokerage account for the townhouse closing.
tickets.evidence: The Velvet Acorn Custody aggregation feed in the planning portal is showing a stale joint brokerage balance, so the liquidity worksheet is not reflecting the current cash and short-term bond positions available for closing;

tickets.title: Coordinate new‑home insurance and liability coverage
tickets.text: Coordinate new‑home insurance and liability coverage for the Nettlewhisk townhouse purchase, replacing the existing renters policy.
tickets.evidence: the agreed new-home insurance and liability coordination is due 2025-10-15.

tickets.title: Perform tax‑lot review for brokerage assets
tickets.text: Perform a tax‑lot review of the taxable ETF positions in the joint Velvet Acorn Custody account to identify suitable lots for sale to fund the townhouse closing cash.
tickets.evidence: the agreed tax-lot review is due 2025-10-09.
